**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Mrs Joyce](../persons.html#787),
I am sorry to say I must ask you to put off your kind visit till next week.

My [sister in law](../persons.html#1604)’s brother, [Charles Walter](../persons.html#1464), has been killed in Alderney by a fall from his dog cart.[^2] He is to be buried on Tuesday, beside his [father ](../persons.html#1461)at Winchester, and the relations will be in and out here to see the poor [invalid sister](../persons.html#1462) so that I cannot venture to have anyone here on my own account.

Next week will be free, except on what ever day they may fix for electing the High school mistress Then I shall be very glad to see you
yours very sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: With envelope addressed to ‘The Honble Mrs.

Joyce/ St John’s Croft/ Winchester’ and postmarked 10 May 1885.

[^2]: Frances (Walter) Yonge and Gertrude Walter had two younger half-brothers of their father’s second marriage of whom the elder was Edward Charles Lethbridge Walter (1854-5 May 1885).
